summary.pl: Klasyczny Minecraft z kilkoma modami Quality of Life wybranymi przez naszą społeczność.
summary.en: Classic Minecraft with a handful of quality-of-life mods chosen by our community.

mods.reason: Required by most of the list
Kotlin runtime — Zoomify and Inventory Profiles Next are written in it. Held to 1.13.14: 1.14 and later need Fabric Loader 0.19.5, and this pack is on 0.19.3. Moving the loader is its own decision

Config screens for Zoomify and friends. Held to 3.9.6: with 3.9.7 the game crashes at start on Fabric Loader 0.19.3. Its mixin into ContainerEventHandler fails inside the loader's MixinExtras 0.5.4 (ClassCastException in FactoryRedirectWrapperMixinTransformer), which its metadata does not show. Measured in a real client, 2026-11-12
Required by Inventory Profiles Next
Required by Controlling
Config screens
Config format used by Traveler's Backpack and Open Parties and Claims

Edits Forge Config API Port settings in game — without it the settings button just says to install this. Modrinth tags it server-only, which is backwards: the jar declares environment "*" and the screen it adds is the client's
Text placeholders — Styled Chat and Mod Menu
Serves server-side content to vanilla clients — graves and shops ride on it
Required by Waystones
Required by Waystones
Permission checks the server mods delegate to LuckPerms
Rendering engine rewrite — the single biggest FPS win
Extra Sodium video options. Held to 0.9.4: 0.9.5 needs Fabric Loader 0.20.1, and this pack is on 0.19.3
Nicer Sodium options screen
Shader support, Sodium-compatible
General game-logic optimisation — helps the server as much as the client
Cuts memory usage
Network stack optimisation
Skips rendering entities behind walls. Held to 1.11.3 until 2026-11-19: 1.12.0 came out on 2026-11-12, and a new version waits seven days
Speeds up immediate-mode rendering
Throttles FPS when the window is unfocused
Keeps far chunks cached beyond the server view distance
Minimap — draws Open Parties and Claims claims natively
Full-screen map, same claim integration
Recipe viewer. 26.2 only has a beta build; EMI and REI have none at all

Required by JEI (>=0.6.3 <1.0.0) — the config library mezz split out of it. Every 26.2 build is a beta. Held to 0.6.11 until 2026-11-16: 0.7.1 came out on 2026-11-09, and a new version waits seven days
JEI's settings screen in game. Since JEI keeps its settings in MezzConfig, Configured no longer opens them, and the button says to install this. Every 26.2 build is a beta
What am I looking at — block and mob tooltips
Shows saturation and what food actually does
Drag-to-move stacks in every inventory
Inventory sorting
Searchable, conflict-aware key bindings

Zoom key — the one thing OptiFine users miss first. One release serves Fabric and NeoForge, so Modrinth lists NeoForge's Kotlin library as required; on Fabric that job is Fabric Language Kotlin's, which this pack carries
Keeps chat off Mojang's reporting pipeline

Third-person animations for what your hands are doing. Held to 1.12.4: with 1.12.7 the game crashes at start on Fabric Loader 0.19.3. Its mixin into Player fails inside the loader's MixinExtras 0.5.4 (ClassCastException in FactoryRedirectWrapperMixinTransformer), which its metadata does not show. Measured in a real client, 2026-11-12
Held torches light the world
Connected textures
Readable debug screen
Lists the pack's mods and opens their settings
Carries the in-game starter guide. Patchouli has no 26.2 build — its newest Fabric release is 26.1
Backpacks — worn, craftable, upgradeable
Discoverable fast-travel points, found rather than granted
Fell a tree with one cut. Server-side, so nothing to install to use it
Death drops go into a grave. Server-side via Polymer
Land claims, parties and per-player chunk forceloading. Beta is the only 26.2 build; limits read from LuckPerms
Permissions and the rank ladder that sets claim and forceload limits
Puts the vanilla commands behind LuckPerms nodes, so staff need no operator status
Wildcards in LuckPerms meta keys — without it the selector weights that protect staff from each other need one key per command
Moves a player up the LuckPerms ladder once they have played long enough

Sells the Mistrz rank. Only its `rank` module is on, because it is the one thing on Fabric 26.2 that can take payment and grant a LuckPerms group: requirements and reward commands both run as console, so the player needs no LuckPerms node to be promoted. Every other Fuji module ships disabled and stays that way — /home, /tpa, chat and nicknames already belong to other mods here

Mute, warn and freeze — vanilla offers only kick and ban. Held to 26.2: from 1.1.0 its /kick, and from 1.2.0 its /ban, /tempban and /unban, take the place of the vanilla commands docs/staff.txt is built on, and whether a Moderator still cannot ban an Administrator through them is untested. Moving is its own decision, with a test on the stand
Map editing for builders and staff. Server-side, so vanilla clients still connect
Draws the WorldEdit selection box
Player and admin trade shops, item for item
/home, /tpa, /rtp, /back
Logs every block change and rolls grief back

Paper-style ore obfuscation — the server sends fake block data underground, so an x-ray client sees noise instead of veins. Held to 1.5.0: 1.6.0 needs Fabric Loader 0.19.4 and 1.7.0 needs 0.19.5, and this pack is on 0.19.3. 1.6.0 also starts sending anonymous bStats metrics unless they are turned off
Password login. Without it an offline-mode server lets anyone take any name
World pregeneration — keeps first exploration from lagging
Profiler for when the server does lag
Dynamic server-side performance tuning
Chat formatting driven by LuckPerms ranks
Player-set nicknames, permission-gated
Tab list — header, footer and per-player line, driven by the same LuckPerms ranks as chat

Staff can look without being seen. Held to 1.6.15: with 1.6.16 the server does not start on Fabric Loader 0.19.3. Its mixin into Player fails inside the loader's MixinExtras 0.5.4 (ClassCastException in FactoryRedirectWrapperMixinTransformer), although the jar asks only for loader 0.18.4, so check-deps cannot see it. Measured on a server stand, 2026-11-12; 1.6.16 itself only fixes a boss bar
Required by Starter Kit
Kits. Fabric 26.2 has no repeatable /kit mod, so this covers the join kit and staff handouts

shaders.reason: Default shader — semi-realistic light and water, vanilla's look kept intact
The same pack pushed further, for players who want the transformed look
